page.overview:
What is Meditite?

Meditite is a humanoid Pokémon with a blue and white body. Its head is white with large black eyes and pink cheek spots. Male Meditite have higher "hair" than the females. It has long limbs with blue hands and white feet. Its wrists and lower body are white.

Shiny Meditite are red and slightly pinkish instead of blue and white.

Meditite are known for their extensive training in mountainous areas. They usually eat minimal food and rarely sleep as their day mainly consists of deep focus and meditation, though it often loses focus during these practices, leading to its training to become never-ending. While deep in meditation, this allows them to levitate off the ground.

Meditite evolves into Medicham starting at level 37.
